decisions.question: Which 3-point MACE row from FDA NDA 209053 EMDAC briefing (2023) is the review's value?

reviewer_A.row: Table 19, ITT Population End of Study, FREEDOM (CLP-107)

reviewer_B.row: 3-Point MACE End of Treatment row (span verbatim in reviewB_extraction.json)

decisions.rule_applied: B-prime 'Timepoint': the prespecified analysis at the end of randomised follow-up (on-study / end-of-study ITT); on-treatment or end-of-treatment analyses are sensitivity analyses
decisions.decision: End-of-study row adopted: HR 1.24 (0.90, 1.70). End-of-treatment row recorded as a sensitivity value, not discarded.
decisions.why: Neither reviewer erred on reading; the disagreement is a timepoint/analysis-set selection that the registered rule decides. B's row is the on-treatment analysis.
decisions.consequence: The typed effect object must carry `censoring: on-study|on-treatment` and `timepoint`; a value without them is UNTYPED. Foundation item for the type system (FN/CGX).

decisions.question: Is the abstract's 'major cardiovascular events ... HR 0.82' the 3-point composite the review pools?

reviewer_B.basis: abstract does not enumerate the components; refused to relabel

decisions.rule_applied: Source ladder: value from level 1; endpoint IDENTITY from the lowest level that enumerates components -- registry design_outcomes (level 3, AACT snapshot, offline)
decisions.decision: Endpoint identity resolved from AACT design_outcomes for NCT03819153 (MACE = CV death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke); value stays level 1; identity cited at level 3. B's refusal was CORRECT on the held set B was given. AACT span now recorded (17 Sep); censoring caveat added.
decisions.why: B was sealed to abstracts + two FDA texts and had no registry record; the harness holds the registry record. The resolution is by an additional held source, not by overruling B.
decisions.consequence: FLOW may be pooled only once the AACT design_outcomes row is recorded as a source with its verbatim title span and the snapshot identity; not yet done on the page.

aact_span.measure_verbatim: Number of Participants From Time of Randomization to Time to First Occurrence of a Major Adverse Cardiovascular Event (MACE): Acute Myocardial Infarction (Non Fatal); Non-fatal Stroke; and CV Death
aact_span.description_verbatim: Number of participants who reported first occurence of non-fatal acute myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, and CV death combined data were presented from Week 0 up to Week 234 during on-treatment period. MACE consisted of non-fatal acute myocardial infarction, cardiovascular death and non-fatal stroke. First on-treatment period is defined as period from date of first dose until first time where no dose had been administered within 5 weeks (35 days) or end of the in-trial period, whichever came first.
component_rows: Number of Participants From Time of Randomization to Time to Occurrence of Each of the Individual Components of the Confirmatory Secondary MACE Endpoint: Non-fatal Myocardial Infarction
Number of Participants From Time of Randomization to Time to Occurrence of Each of the Individual Components of the Confirmatory Secondary MACE Endpoint: Non-fatal Stroke

decisions.caveat: The registry description of the composite says 'during on-treatment period' while the component rows say 'in-trial period'; the abstract's HR 0.82 is the in-trial (on-study) analysis per the publication. Endpoint IDENTITY (components) is resolved at level 3; the CENSORING axis for the 0.82 value must be typed from the publication (level 1) by the TY lane's axis 8 before FLOW pools -- not assumed here.

decisions.value_span: Table 10 (label p.25): 'Composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke (time to first occurrence) 254 (14.4) 212 (12.0) 0.82 (0.68, 0.98) 0.0289'; N=1766 placebo, N=1767 OZEMPIC 1 mg (all randomized); Cox model stratified by baseline SGLT2-inhibitor use

The x-axis is truncated at 52 months where approximately 5% of the population was in the trial.' + 'followed for a median of 41 months' (p.24)
decisions.reading_PROPOSED: in-trial (randomization to end of trial) on all randomized patients -- end-of-study censoring under the declared binding axis; the value equals the NEJM abstract value held at level 1 (0.82, 0.68-0.98), now backed at level 2 with the observation period stated by the regulator.
decisions.what_it_is_not: not the prospective SAP/protocol (NEJM protocol and supplementary appendix unreachable: Cloudflare 403; the S-025 FDA review package is not posted). The registry design_outcomes rows remain contradictory (composite: on-treatment; components: in-trial) -- ADJ-GLP1-002 stands as the record of that contradiction.
